{{Quote|Is that what got the ''Juliupper''?''"<br />"''Bug things.|An individual and the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], on the ''Juliupper''{{'s}} destruction|<ref name="VP" />}}
The '''''Juliupper''''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] equipped with [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]] and a [[titanium-alloy]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]].<ref name="VP" /> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> it was one of several [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that attempted to evacuate the residents of the<ref name="VP" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Julevian system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]], which was located in the [[Julevian system]], while the planet was [[Destruction of Sernpidal|destroyed]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] by [[Yo'gand's Core|pulling]] Sernpidal's [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dobido]] into the planet.<ref name="VP" />

Several Yuuzhan Vong [[grutchin]]s, [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] creatures that tore through starships, attacked the ''Juliupper'' over Sernpidal, boring through the vessel's hull and attacking its ion [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. After the shuttle's [[Unidentified pilot (Juliupper)|pilot]] called for assistance, the<ref name="VP" /> [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]<ref name="MFM">''[[Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual]]''</ref> [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] moved to assist, [[Death/Legends|killing]] one of the attacking grutchins with its [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]; however, the creatures destroyed the ''Juliupper''.<ref name="VP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Juliupper'' first appeared in the [[1999]] novel [[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime|''Vector Prime'']], written by [[R. A. Salvatore]] as the first volume in the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' novel series.<ref name="VP" />
